```{r mixed-model data prep}
## risk datasets
CRE_admission_patients <- CRE_admission %>%
    select(USUBJID, SPEC_DATE)
CRE_admission_patients <- CRE_admission_patients[!duplicated(CRE_admission_patients$USUBJID), ]

## if need to know the bacterium, use the following dataset
data_wide <- CRE_admission %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Identification_MALDITOF,
    values_from = SPEC_DATE,
    id_cols = USUBJID
  )

CRE_discharge_patients <- CRE_discharge %>%
  select(USUBJID, SPEC_DATE)
CRE_discharge_patients <- CRE_discharge_patients[!duplicated(CRE_discharge_patients$USUBJID), ]
CRE_discharge_admission_patients <- merge(CRE_discharge_patients, CRE_admission_patients, by="USUBJID", all=T)
CRE_discharge_admission_patients<- CRE_discharge_admission_patients %>%
  mutate(CRE_admission = ifelse(!is.na(SPEC_DATE.y), "CRE", "No CRE"),
         CRE_discharge = ifelse(!is.na(SPEC_DATE.x), "CRE", "No CRE"))

CREC_admission <- CRE_admission %>%
  filter(Identification_MALDITOF == "Escherichia coli") %>%
  select(USUBJID, SPEC_DATE)
CREC_admission <- CREC_admission[!duplicated(CREC_admission$USUBJID),]

CREC_discharge <- CRE_discharge %>%
  filter(Identification_MALDITOF == "Escherichia coli") %>%
  select(USUBJID, SPEC_DATE)
CREC_discharge <- CREC_discharge[!duplicated(CREC_discharge$USUBJID),]
CREC_discharge_admission <- merge(CREC_discharge, CREC_admission, by="USUBJID", all=T)
CREC_discharge_admission<- CREC_discharge_admission %>%
  mutate(CRE_admission = ifelse(!is.na(SPEC_DATE.y), "CRE", "No CRE"),
         CRE_discharge = ifelse(!is.na(SPEC_DATE.x), "CRE", "No CRE"))

CRKP_admission <- CRE_admission %>%
  filter(Identification_MALDITOF == "Klebsiella pneumoniae") %>%
  select(USUBJID, SPEC_DATE)
CRKP_admission <- CRKP_admission[!duplicated(CRKP_admission$USUBJID),]

CRKP_discharge <- CRE_discharge %>%
  filter(Identification_MALDITOF == "Klebsiella pneumoniae") %>%
  select(USUBJID, SPEC_DATE)
CRKP_discharge <- CRKP_discharge[!duplicated(CRKP_discharge$USUBJID),]
CRKP_discharge_admission <- merge(CRKP_discharge, CRKP_admission, by="USUBJID", all=T)
CRKP_discharge_admission<- CRKP_discharge_admission %>%
  mutate(CRE_admission = ifelse(!is.na(SPEC_DATE.y), "CRE", "No CRE"),
         CRE_discharge = ifelse(!is.na(SPEC_DATE.x), "CRE", "No CRE"))

## antibiotic use in hospital data
antibiotics <- AbCurrent_Detail %>% 
  select(USUBJID, ANB_HOSP_START_DATE, ANB_HOSP_END_DATE, agent) %>%
  mutate(DOT = as.numeric((ANB_HOSP_END_DATE-ANB_HOSP_START_DATE)/86400 +1))

antibiotics <- antibiotics %>%
  group_by(USUBJID, agent) %>%
  summarise(DOT = sum(DOT)) 

#View(GenInfo %>% select(JOB_SPECIFY,JOB,JOB_final)%>%unique)
```



```{r admission models}
#select CRE dataset: CRE_admission_patients, CREC_admission, CRKP_admission
CRE_dataset <- CRE_discharge_patients

riskdata1 <- cbind(Admission,Discharge[,c(2,6,11:40)],AbCurrent[,c(2, 6)]) # same number of rows

riskdata2 <- cbind(GenInfo[, c(2,7,12,13,14,25,31,36)],InvasiveHistory[,c(2,12)], MedicationHistory[,c(2,12)],TravelHistory[,c(2,12)],HealthcareHistory[,c(2,12)])

riskdata3 <- merge(riskdata1[,c(1:63, 65:95, 97)], riskdata2[,c(1:8,10,12,14,16)], by = "USUBJID", all = T)

riskdata4 <- merge(riskdata3, CRE_dataset,by = "USUBJID", all = T)

riskdata <- merge(riskdata4,AbCurrentDOT, by = "USUBJID", all = T)

riskdata <- within(riskdata, {
  province <- as.factor(ifelse(SITEID %in% c("008","010","071","073", "160", "161"), 1, 2))
  gender <- factor(GENDER)
  age_cat <- factor(age_cat_Charlson, levels = 0:4, labels = c("less than 50", "50-59", "60-69", "70-79", "80 or older"))
  CRE <- as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(SPEC_DATE), 1, 0))
  ward <- as.factor(ifelse(WARD_3 == 1, "surgical", "medical/id"))
  job <- as.factor(ifelse(JOB_final== 6, "farmer",ifelse(JOB_final== 7,"housewife",ifelse(JOB_final == 8, "retired", "all other jobs"))))
  smoking <- as.factor(ifelse(SMOKING == 1, "current smoker", ifelse(SMOKING == 2, "former smoker", "all non-smokers")))
  children<- as.factor(ifelse(CHILDREN == 0, "no children in the household", "with children in the household"))
  married <- as.factor(ifelse(MARITAL ==1, "married", "other"))
  alcohol <- as.factor(ifelse(AlcoholCAGE == 0, "0 problem", "1-4 problem"))
  drug <- as.factor(ifelse(DrugCAGE == 0, "0 problem", "1-4 problem"))
  ambulatory <- as.factor(ifelse(AMBULATORY == 1, "independent", "not independent"))
  diagnosis <- as.factor(ifelse(ICDGroup == "Other", "All other diagnoses",ICDGroup))
  antibiotics<- as.factor(ifelse(is.na(number), "no", "yes"))
  DOT <- ifelse(is.na(DOT), 0, DOT)
})

riskdata <- riskdata %>% 
  mutate(PVCduration = as.numeric(as.Date.POSIXct(riskdata$PVC_TO)- as.Date.POSIXct(riskdata$PVC_FROM))+1,
         UCduration = as.numeric(as.Date.POSIXct(riskdata$UC_TO)- as.Date.POSIXct(riskdata$UC_FROM))) %>%
  mutate(PVCduration = ifelse(is.na(PVCduration), 0, PVCduration),
         UCduration = ifelse(is.na(UCduration), 0, UCduration))


## get group mean and 95%CI, and difference test stats
require("lsmeans")
anova_result <- aov(DOT~CRE, data=riskdata); summary(anova_result)
lsmeans(anova_result, ~CRE); 
t.test(riskdata$DOT); summary(subset(riskdata, riskdata$CRE==1)$number,na.rm=T); summary(riskdata$DOT)


##glm

#variables: ward+job +ADM_FROM+ gender +age+children+alcohol+drug+Ab_history+smoking+ ambulatory+CPD +SEV_RENAL+DIAB_EOD+InvasiveHistory+HealthcareHistory+diagnosis
riskmodel <- glm(CRE ~ province+ ward+job +ADM_FROM+ gender +age+Ab_history+smoking+ ambulatory+CPD +SEV_RENAL+DIAB_EOD+InvasiveHistory+HealthcareHistory+diagnosis, 
                   data = riskdata, 
                   family = binomial) 
summary(riskmodel);
se <- sqrt(diag(vcov(riskmodel))); tab <- cbind(Est = coef(riskmodel), LL = coef(riskmodel) - 1.96 * se, UL = coef(riskmodel) + 1.96 *se); exp(tab)
coef(summary(riskmodel))[,4] #p-value
                   
### MIXED MODEL IN LME4   

#admission model variables CRE: ward+ job+ gender +age+Ab_history+smoking+ambulatory+ CPD+ SEV_RENAL +DIAB_EOD+ InvasiveHistory + HealthcareHistory+ diagnosis
#admission model variables CREC: ward+ job+ gender +age+children+Ab_history+smoking+ CPD +DIAB_EOD+ InvasiveHistory + HealthcareHistory+ diagnosis
#admission model variables CRKP: ward+ gender +age+ ADM_FROM+ Ab_history+ambulatory+ SEV_RENAL +DIAB_EOD+ InvasiveHistory + HealthcareHistory+ diagnosis

# admission model variables ALL: ward+job +ADM_FROM+ gender+age+married+alcohol+drug+children+ Ab_history+smoking+ ambulatory+CPD +SEV_RENAL+ DIAB_NOEOD+ DIAB_EOD+ InvasiveHistory+ HealthcareHistory+diagnosis -- choose those with p-value <0.10 in univariable mixed-effects model

riskmodel_mixed <- glmer(CRE ~ ward+ gender +age+ ADM_FROM+ Ab_history+ambulatory+ SEV_RENAL +DIAB_EOD+ InvasiveHistory + HealthcareHistory+ diagnosis
                         +(1|province), 
                   data = riskdata, 
                   family = binomial,control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),nAGQ = 10)
summary(riskmodel_mixed)
se <- sqrt(diag(vcov(riskmodel_mixed))); tab <- cbind(Est = fixef(riskmodel_mixed), LL = fixef(riskmodel_mixed) - 1.96 * se, UL = fixef(riskmodel_mixed) + 1.96 *se); exp(tab)
coef(summary(riskmodel))[,4] #p-value
    
```


```{r discharge models}
#select CRE dataset: CRE_discharge_admission_patients; CREC_discharge_admission; CRKP_discharge_admission
CRE_dataset <- CRE_discharge_admission_patients

riskdata1 <- cbind(Admission,Discharge[,c(2,6,11:40)],Discharge[,c(2,6,11:40)],AbCurrent[,c(2, 6)]) # same number of rows

riskdata2 <- cbind(GenInfo[, c(2,7,12,13,14,25,31,36)],InvasiveHistory[,c(2,12)], MedicationHistory[,c(2,12)],TravelHistory[,c(2,12)],HealthcareHistory[,c(2,12)])

riskdata3 <- merge(riskdata1[,c(1:63, 65:95, 97)], riskdata2[,c(1:8,10,12,14,16)], by = "USUBJID", all = T)

riskdata4 <- merge(riskdata3, CRE_dataset,by = "USUBJID", all = T)

riskdata <- merge(riskdata4,AbCurrentDOT, by = "USUBJID", all = T)

riskdata <- within(riskdata, {
  province <- as.factor(ifelse(SITEID %in% c("008","010","071","073", "160", "161"), 1, 2))
  gender <- factor(GENDER)
  age_cat <- factor(age_cat_Charlson, levels = 0:4, labels = c("less than 50", "50-59", "60-69", "70-79", "80 or older"))
  CRE <- as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(SPEC_DATE.x), 1, 0))
  CRE_admission_all <- as.factor(ifelse(CRE_admission %in% c("No CRE", NA), "no", "yes"))
  ward <- as.factor(ifelse(WARD_3 == 1, "surgical", "medical/id"))
  job <- as.factor(ifelse(JOB_final== 6, "farmer",ifelse(JOB_final== 7,"housewife",ifelse(JOB_final == 8, "retired", "all other jobs"))))
  smoking <- as.factor(ifelse(SMOKING == 1, "current smoker", ifelse(SMOKING == 2, "former smoker", "all non-smokers")))
  children<- as.factor(ifelse(CHILDREN == 0, "no children in the household", "with children in the household"))
  married <- as.factor(ifelse(MARITAL ==1, "married", "other"))
  alcohol <- as.factor(ifelse(AlcoholCAGE == 0, "0 problem", "1-4 problem"))
  drug <- as.factor(ifelse(DrugCAGE == 0, "0 problem", "1-4 problem"))
  ambulatory <- as.factor(ifelse(AMBULATORY == 1, "independent", "not independent"))
  diagnosis <- as.factor(ifelse(ICDGroup == "Other", "All other diagnoses",ICDGroup))
  antibiotics<- as.factor(ifelse(is.na(number), "no", "yes"))
  DOT <- ifelse(is.na(DOT), 0, DOT)
})

riskdata <- riskdata %>% 
  mutate(PVCduration = as.numeric(as.Date.POSIXct(riskdata$PVC_TO)- as.Date.POSIXct(riskdata$PVC_FROM))+1,
         UCduration = as.numeric(as.Date.POSIXct(riskdata$UC_TO)- as.Date.POSIXct(riskdata$UC_FROM))) %>%
  mutate(PVCduration = ifelse(is.na(PVCduration), 0, PVCduration),
         UCduration = ifelse(is.na(UCduration), 0, UCduration))


##MODELLING

#variables: ward+job +ADM_FROM+ gender +age+Ab_history+smoking+ ambulatory+CPD +SEV_RENAL+DIAB_EOD+InvasiveHistory+HealthcareHistory+diagnosis
riskmodel <- glm(CRE ~ CRE_admission_all+ward+province + gender +age+job+alcohol+drug+HealthcareHistory + SEV_RENAL+diagnosis+SURGERY + antibiotics, 
                   data = riskdata, 
                   family = binomial) 
summary(riskmodel);
se <- sqrt(diag(vcov(riskmodel))); tab <- cbind(Est = coef(riskmodel), LL = coef(riskmodel) - 1.96 * se, UL = coef(riskmodel) + 1.96 *se); exp(tab)
coef(summary(riskmodel))[,4] #p-value
                   
### MIXED MODEL IN LME4   

# discharge model variables all to check before final model including only those with p<0.10 in univariable model: CRE_admission_all+ward+job +ADM_FROM+ gender +age+married+alcohol+drug+children+Ab_history+smoking+ ambulatory+CPD +SEV_RENAL+ DIAB_NOEOD+ DIAB_EOD+ InvasiveHistory+ HealthcareHistory+diagnosis+PittScore+ICU+CVC+ PVC+UC+SURGERY+IID+antibiotics

#discharge model variables CRE: los+CRE_admission_all+ward +ADM_FROM+ gender +age+Ab_history+CPD +diagnosis+PVC+SURGERY+IID + DOT
#discharge model variables CREC: los+CRE_admission_all+ward + gender +age+Ab_history+CPD+InvasiveHistory+ +diagnosis+PVC+SURGERY + DOT
#discharge model variables CRKP: los+CRE_admission_all+ward + gender +age+job+alcohol+drug+HealthcareHistory + SEV_RENAL+diagnosis+SURGERY + DOT

## DOT and antibiotics to be evaluated separately, in two separate final models with the same set of other variables for each riskdata

riskmodel_mixed <- glmer(CRE ~ los+CRE_admission_all+ward + gender +age+job+alcohol+drug+HealthcareHistory + SEV_RENAL+diagnosis+SURGERY + DOT
                         +(1|province), 
                   data = riskdata, 
                   family = binomial,control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),nAGQ = 10)
summary(riskmodel_mixed)
se <- sqrt(diag(vcov(riskmodel_mixed))); tab <- cbind(Est = fixef(riskmodel_mixed), LL = fixef(riskmodel_mixed) - 1.96 * se, UL = fixef(riskmodel_mixed) + 1.96 *se); exp(tab)
coef(summary(riskmodel_mixed))[,4] #p-value
    
```

```{r adding antibiotic agents to discharge models}

##CRE_discharge_admission_patients; CREC_discharge_admission; CRKP_discharge_admission
CRE_dataset <- CRKP_discharge_admission

riskdata1 <- cbind(Admission,Discharge[,c(2,6,11:40)],Discharge[,c(2,6,11:40)],AbCurrent[,c(2, 6)]) # same number of rows

riskdata2 <- cbind(GenInfo[, c(2,7,12,13,14,25,31,36)],InvasiveHistory[,c(2,12)], MedicationHistory[,c(2,12)],TravelHistory[,c(2,12)],HealthcareHistory[,c(2,12)])

riskdata3 <- merge(riskdata1[,c(1:63, 65:95, 97)], riskdata2[,c(1:8,10,12,14,16)], by = "USUBJID", all = T)

riskdata4 <- merge(riskdata3, CRE_dataset,by = "USUBJID", all = T)

riskdata <- merge(riskdata4,AbCurrentDOT, by = "USUBJID", all = T)

riskdata <- within(riskdata, {
  province <- as.factor(ifelse(SITEID %in% c("008","010","071","073", "160", "161"), 1, 2))
  gender <- factor(GENDER)
  age_cat <- factor(age_cat_Charlson, levels = 0:4, labels = c("less than 50", "50-59", "60-69", "70-79", "80 or older"))
  CRE <- as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(SPEC_DATE.x), 1, 0))
  CRE_admission_all <- as.factor(ifelse(CRE_admission %in% c("No CRE", NA), "no", "yes"))
  ward <- as.factor(ifelse(WARD_3 == 1, "surgical", "medical/id"))
  job <- as.factor(ifelse(JOB_final== 6, "farmer",ifelse(JOB_final== 7,"housewife",ifelse(JOB_final == 8, "retired", "all other jobs"))))
  smoking <- as.factor(ifelse(SMOKING == 1, "current smoker", ifelse(SMOKING == 2, "former smoker", "all non-smokers")))
  children<- as.factor(ifelse(CHILDREN == 0, "no children in the household", "with children in the household"))
  married <- as.factor(ifelse(MARITAL ==1, "married", "other"))
  alcohol <- as.factor(ifelse(AlcoholCAGE == 0, "0 problem", "1-4 problem"))
  drug <- as.factor(ifelse(DrugCAGE == 0, "0 problem", "1-4 problem"))
  ambulatory <- as.factor(ifelse(AMBULATORY == 1, "independent", "not independent"))
  diagnosis <- as.factor(ifelse(ICDGroup == "Other", "All other diagnoses",ICDGroup))
  antibiotics<- as.factor(ifelse(is.na(number), "no", "yes"))
  DOT <- ifelse(is.na(DOT), 0, DOT)
})

#riskdata with antibiotics use in hospital
#select relevant/potentially impactful antibiotics in this admission: 
## Amoxicillin_clavulanicAcid, Ampicillin_sulbactam, Cefamandol, Cefazolin, Cefoperazone, Cefoperazone_sulbactam, Cefotaxime, Cefoxitin, Cefpodoxime_proxetil, Ceftazidime, Ceftizoxime, Ceftriaxone, Cefuroxime, Ciprofloxacin, Gentamicin, Levofloxacin, Metronidazole_IV, Metronidazole_oral

riskdata_ab1 <- merge(riskdata, subset(antibiotics, antibiotics$agent == "Amoxicillin_clavulanicAcid"), by = "USUBJID", all = T)
riskdata_ab1 <- riskdata_ab1 %>%
  mutate(Amoxicillin_clavulanicAcid = ifelse(is.na(agent), "no", "yes"))
riskdata_ab2 <- merge(riskdata_ab1[,c(1:127, 130)], subset(antibiotics, antibiotics$agent == "Ampicillin_sulbactam"), by = "USUBJID", all = T)
riskdata_ab2 <- riskdata_ab2 %>%
  mutate(Ampicillin_sulbactam = ifelse(is.na(agent), "no", "yes"))

riskdata_ab3 <- riskdata_ab3 %>%
  mutate(Cefamandol = ifelse(is.na(agent), "no", "yes"))

riskdata_ab6 <- riskdata_ab6 %>%

### MIXED MODELS

#Amoxicillin_clavulanicAcid+ Ampicillin_sulbactam +Cefamandol+ Cefazolin+ Cefoperazone+ Cefoperazone_sulbactam+ Cefotaxime+ Cefoxitin+ Cefpodoxime_proxetil+ Ceftazidime+ Ceftizoxime+ Ceftriaxone+ Cefuroxime+ Ciprofloxacin+ Gentamicin+ Levofloxacin+ Metronidazole_IV+ Metronidazole_oral

riskmodel_mixed <- glmer(CRE ~ SEV_RENAL+CRE_admission_all + DOT.x + Amoxicillin_clavulanicAcid+ Ampicillin_sulbactam +Cefamandol+ Cefazolin+ Cefoperazone+ Cefoperazone_sulbactam+ Cefotaxime+ Cefoxitin+ Cefpodoxime_proxetil+ Ceftazidime+ Ceftizoxime+ Ceftriaxone+ Cefuroxime+ Ciprofloxacin+ Gentamicin+ Levofloxacin+ Metronidazole_IV+ Metronidazole_oral  
                         +(1|province), 
                   data = riskdata_ab, 
                   family = binomial,control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),nAGQ = 10)
summary(riskmodel_mixed)
se <- sqrt(diag(vcov(riskmodel_mixed))); tab <- cbind(Est = fixef(riskmodel_mixed), LL = fixef(riskmodel_mixed) - 1.96 * se, UL = fixef(riskmodel_mixed) + 1.96 *se); exp(tab)
coef(summary(riskmodel_mixed))[,4] #p-value

                   data = riskdata_ab, 
                   family = binomial) 
summary(riskmodel);
se <- sqrt(diag(vcov(riskmodel))); tab <- cbind(Est = coef(riskmodel), LL = coef(riskmodel) - 1.96 * se, UL = coef(riskmodel) + 1.96 *se); exp(tab)
coef(summary(riskmodel))[,4] #p-value
```
